description: This Perl script analyzes the output of 'git verify-pack -v' to compute various statistics such as object sizes, path sizes, delta trees, depths, and optionally outputs detailed tree structures, filenames, or raw data depending on command-line options. It is used for inspecting Git pack files and their object delta chains, including visualization of delta trees and statistical summaries.

methods.name: stats
methods.description: Computes statistical measures (count, total, min, max, mean, median, std_dev) for a list of numbers.

methods.name: print_stats
methods.description: Formats and outputs statistical data for a dataset.

methods.name: dig
methods.description: Recursively traverses the delta tree starting from a root object, calculating and optionally printing delta tree structure and statistics.
